title: Browser history
statementMd:
Simulate browser history starting at `homepage`. `['visit', url]` goes to a new page and clears forward history, `['back', n]` moves back up to `n` steps, `['forward', n]` moves forward up to `n` steps. Return the current page after each `back` and `forward`.

**Example:** `browser_ops("a", [["visit", "b"], ["visit", "c"], ["back", 1], ["forward", 1…)` returns `["b", "c"]`.
hints: Keep a list and an index.
